message:
Fixed. In `src/payments/partial-refund.js`, `percent` is on a 0–100 scale, but the code multiplied by it directly, so a 50% refund came out 50 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` now passes all 20 tests. I changed nothing outside `src/payments`.
